summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Gestion Movil (caja/inventario/reparaciones) Expo app. All 21 backend pytest tests passed against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend mobile-viewport Playwright run validated: tab navigation across all 4 tabs (Caja, Inventario, Reparaciones, Más), end-to-end Ingreso creation (balance updated 1,300 -> 2,077 RD$), Inventario list & filter chips render, Reparaciones segmented control (Activas/Entregadas) renders existing repair, Más shows 7d/30d summaries + inventory/repairs counters. No red screens, no JS errors blocking flow.

minor.issue: RepairUpdate.status is plain Optional[str] (no Literal), so any string value (e.g. 'wrong') is accepted on update. Create endpoint enforces Literal correctly. Recommend enforcing the same Literal on update for data integrity.
PhoneUpdate.condition / status are Optional[str] without Literal validation; same concern as above.

issues: Date label shows 'Lunes, 29 De Junio' - Spanish convention should be lowercase 'de junio' (cosmetic).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated.
React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. Some library (likely a bottom sheet or icon lib) still uses element.ref. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Tighten RepairUpdate.status and PhoneUpdate.condition/status to Literal types to reject invalid values on PUT.
OPTIONAL: Fix Spanish date casing 'De Junio' -> 'de junio' on Caja header.
OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow*/pointerEvents style props to recommended replacements to clear console deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured, all endpoints exclude MongoDB _id via projection or pop, all use uuid string ids, and async/await is used throughout.
Update models (PhoneUpdate/RepairUpdate) lose Literal type safety - tracked above as minor.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly (no hardcoded URLs).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (tab nav + ingreso creation + lists across all 4 tabs)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 extra transaction via UI (TEST_UI_ingreso RD$777, category venta). All TEST_* records cleaned up by backend pytest teardown except the seeded ones from main agent and the UI-created TEST_UI_ingreso which remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is no-auth, RD$ currency. Backend at /api/* on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Key testIDs: tab-{caja,inventario,reparaciones,mas}, btn-new-{ingreso,egreso}, input-amount, chip-cat-{venta,reparacion,otro}, input-description, btn-submit-tx, btn-add-phone, input-{brand,model,imei,color,buy-price,sell-price,stock}, btn-submit-phone, chip-filter-{todos,nuevo,usado,reacondicionado}, btn-add-repair, segment-{activas,entregadas}, input-{client-name,client-phone,device,fault,cost,notes}, btn-submit-repair. Photo picker requires native media perms - skip in web automation. Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_api.py for regression.
